title: Linguistic effects beyond natural-movie covariates

titles: Brain Treebank naturalistic movie/language intracranial recordings

scientific_question: Do prespecified linguistic features improve held-out neural-response prediction beyond speaker, acoustics, visual motion and word timing under person/movie and temporal separation?
primary_outputs: The full-minus-nuisance held-out neural prediction contrast on identical scalar response rows; negative, zero or inconclusive increments are valid empirical outcomes.

recording_contract.neural: Author quickstart reads sub_<id>_trial<id>.h5, group data, electrode_<number> one-dimensional arrays; sampling frequency2048Hz and voltage plotted in microvolts per author source. No HDF5 neural array header/value independently opened because recordings are compressed in large ZIPs.
recording_contract.labels: Actual transcript CSV header includes text, lemma, pos, deprel, sentence_idx, word_idx, idx_in_sentence, start/end, gpt2_surprisal, mel/RMS/pitch, motion/brightness and speaker features. Subject metadata JSON identifies movie; electrode-label/localization archives provide anatomy.
recording_contract.time_alignment: Actual timing CSV header is type,movie_time,start_time,end_time,trig_type,index,diff. Author code maps word start/end movie times to neural sample indices from nearest trigger plus2048Hz interpolation. Alignment error and dropped triggers remain empirical checks.

primary.name: delta_r2
primary.aggregation: Compute held-block R² full-minus-nuisance; equal-average blocks within electrode, electrodes within person, then people.
primary.rationale: This revision prospectively selects the SSE-based signed delta R² estimand because it penalizes constant bias; either sign is scientifically valid. A larger increment alone is not more accurate understanding and can result from weakening nuisance prediction. Any programme ranking uses absolute full-model held-target R² against an independently frozen operator-owned competent nuisance/reference procedure. Candidate-supplied paired predictions alone support descriptive contrasts, with current trusted comparator binding absent. Submitted claim correctness is error against the independently computed contrast regardless of sign. Historical delta-EV remains distinct.

secondary: delta_explained_variance computed separately because residual variance ignores constant bias
Absolute nuisance/full R² and EV, per-person/electrode/block contrasts and exclusion accounting
Refitted joint linguistic temporal-shift contrasts and descriptive add-one rank where assumptions hold

comparators.name: Fixed nuisance-only encoding model
comparators.inputs: Speaker, acoustics, visual motion and word timing, no linguistic features
comparators.procedure: Independent operator freezes the nuisance recipe, training-only selection, fitted artifact and held-out predictions before candidate outcome inspection. A proposed ridge/GLM uses identical response/folds; no competent native fit or trusted comparator binding is delivered. Candidate cannot replace or degrade the nuisance output.

comparators.name: Same model plus linguistic features
comparators.inputs: Same nuisance features plus prespecified lexical/syntax regressors
comparators.procedure: Matched capacity/selection policy needed so feature contribution is not a search-budget difference.

comparators.name: Refitted linguistic temporal-shift control
comparators.inputs: All linguistic columns jointly shifted within uniform-time blocks; nuisance unchanged
comparators.procedure: Source utility exists for uniform grids only; native irregular word-time conditional null needs a separately justified construction.

evaluation.uncertainty: Source paired participant bootstrap describes selected-cohort contrasts and omits intervals for one person. Repeated stimuli, common model training and clinical electrode selection require additional treatment before population inference; null rank is descriptive, not a calibrated p-value.
evaluation.failure_policy: Reject constant target blocks, nonfinite values, duplicate/missing/extra rows or split-block outputs. Negative increments remain valid; do not select favorable electrodes after testing. Full constant predictions follow the predeclared report/reject policy.
